description:
A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial emInspeção, Verificação, Testes eCertificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando adiscriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Se você tem como valores, integridade, espírito empreendedor e inovação, o seu lugar é aqui! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!.

Descrição do emprego
  • Conhecimento e interpretação de desenhos, projetos e listas técnicas.
    Conhecimento em normas construtivas, de inspeção, ensaios não destrutivos, NR’s, elaboração de procedimentos e outras;
  • Definição de metodologia de inspeção para diferentes escopos de integridade.
  • Definição de técnicas de inspeção, convencionais e não convencionais, adequadas para cada aplicação;
  • Garantir a execução do escopo da norma NR-13, quando aplicável.
  • Revisar e aprovar relatórios relacionados a inspeções de integridade de equipamentos e serviços;
  • Detalhar recomendações técnicas e prazos de inspeção após a avaliação de cada equipamento;
  • Avaliação de prontuários de equipamentos;
  • Elaboração de plano de inspeção e teste;
  • Elaborar projetos de alteração e reparo, de acordo com os requisitos normativos aplicáveis;
  • Treinamento da equipe técnica;
  • Orientação e acompanhamento das atividades;
  • Reuniões de alinhamento técnico;
Qualificações
  • Ensino técnico em Mecânica;
  • Conhecimentos em inspeção de integridade eNR 13
  • Experiência em estruturas primárias, secundárias e terciarias
Informações Adicionais

O que você vai encontrar na SGS?

  • Um ambiente de desafios com muitas oportunidades de mudanças e transformações.
  • Oportunidades incríveis para você, profissional apaixonado e motivado que deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e contribuir para o sucesso contínuo de nossa empresa.
  • Comprometimento em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.
  • Uma empresa com um forte compromisso com a responsabilidade em saúde, segurança e meio ambiente. Garantimos locais de trabalho seguros e saudáveis e protegemos o meio ambiente.
  • Integridade, qualidade e profissionalismo.

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Desconto em alguns cursos na SGS Academy.
  • Descontos em farmácias Conveniadas;
  • A FIA - Fundação Instituto de Administração;

Regime de trabalho: Híbrido

Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

Horário de trabalho: Segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 as 17h00 com 1h de intervalo

Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, a pessoa candidata declara:

  • Estar em condições técnicas para o desempenho das atividades de trabalho.
  • Ao compartilhar informações, você confirma que elas possuem total veracidade, e está ciente e de acordo que a SGSestá em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre oTratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais(LGPD).Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com a SGS, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: MEDICO CLINICO (EMERGENCIA) - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar consultas no pronto atendimento, unificando dados contidos em prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos;
  • Passar em visita aos pacientes internados, avaliando a recuperação dos mesmos;
  • Efetuar pequenas intervenções cirúrgicas que não exijam corpo clínico especializado;
  • Encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Urgência e Emergência
  • Experiência de 6 meses na função.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
Additional information

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 12h semanais

Horário: 19:00 - 07:00 ou 07:00 - 19:00

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

title: Automation Engineer, Electrical
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire an Automation Engineer, Electrical.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair, and maintenance work, including diagnostics, troubleshooting, and repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment, as well as electrical and control systems, across the MacGregor product range and third-party products, if needed.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e., the US, South and Central America, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to the company standards.

This role is part of our Global Services Division. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent.

What you’ll need to succeed

Your main discipline is automation and software. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have good communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

  • At least 5 years working directly with software and automation;
  • Education within the electrical, control and automation field. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education;
  • Previous experience in the maritime/shipping industry and with shipboard equipment (cranes) is essential.
  • Somatic and electrical components knowledge
  • Ability to write reports and documentation electronically
  • Ability to work with a flexible daily schedule and be available for short-notice travel assignments
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Proficient in English language - both verbal and written
Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional information

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English.

title: Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)
description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador.
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque.
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas.
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente.
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas.
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção.
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas.
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio.
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa.
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores.
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA.
  • Representar eventualmente a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências.
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida.
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho.
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS.
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações.
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Registro no MTE
  • Conhecimento em legislação de segurança do trabalho e normas regulamentadoras (NR)
  • Bons conhecimentos em informática e ferramentas de gestão
  • Habilidade de comunicação e interação com equipes

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia: desconto em medicamentos e produtos diversos para higiene pessoal
  • Alimentação no local
  • GymPass / Seguro de Vida
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas de operação portuária e logística de acordo com os mais elevados padrões de qualidade e segurança, respeito ao indivíduo e ao meio ambiente, agregando máximo valor aos acionistas e à sociedade de forma ética e inovadora.

Resumo

Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança; design de soluções baseadas em microsserviços e integrações assíncronas com mensageria; integração de sistemas e automação de processos, visando alta disponibilidade e consistência das informações; participação em decisões técnicas de arquitetura; colaboração em ambientes ágeis; apoio na implantação e monitoramento de aplicações em AWS.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança;

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as API, ASME, and OSHA.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Diferenciais que são um plus por aqui:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, helping publishers maximize revenue by building strong, transparent, and diversified demand partnerships. We work with leading DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, and agencies worldwide to create a more competitive auction environment that drives higher fill rates and stronger returns for publishers across web, app, and CTV. This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to drastically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand‑Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply‑Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partners.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and session RPMs, CPMs for our publishers’ inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities
  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top‑tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high‑level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non‑Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from non‑Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers’ inventories by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.
  • Technical Integration & Operational Oversight – Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary header bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low‑latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high‑growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on‑time and continue to ensure that we do not have issues paying our publisher payments are always received on‑time.
  • Integration Process Management: Work closely with our ad ops and engineering teams to optimize and manage the technical onboarding lifecycle process, including seamless communication between ad ops and demand partner setup on new publishers, from initial testing to full launch and optimization.
  • Communication & Reporting – High‑Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem including header bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator & Financial Acumen: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to solve problems, initiate partnerships via cold outreach, negotiate and present to senior leader, executive‑level contacts.
  • Organization: Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Bonus Qualifications (A Major Plus)
  • Deep DSP Network: Existing contacts and relationships with key decision‑makers at The Trade Desk or other major DSPs and SSPs/Trading Desks.
  • Trade Desk Experience: Previous employment experience at The Trade Desk or a similar Tier‑1 DSP.
  • Global Focus: Experience managing demand partners and monetization across diverse international markets (EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre o Banco de Talentos

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo. Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias.

Criamos o Banco de Talentos para acelerar o processo de recrutamento e seleção, trazendo maior transparência para os candidatos, e mais agilidade para o time interno trabalhando com este processo. Se você curtiu e se identificou com a nossa empresa, inscreva-se em nosso Banco de Talentos! Seja a primeira pessoa a ser considerada para oportunidades na BDC.

Sobre a área e a vaga

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de integração contínua/entrega contínua (CI/CD) no Gitlab;
  • Realizar monitoramento, escalabilidade e automação de processos de implantação;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das práticas de DevOps;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a entrega de software;
  • Manter ferramentas de análise de código e de segurança integradas com a pipeline, como Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Manter documentação técnica detalhada e compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe;
  • Participar na configuração e gerenciamento de recursos em ambientes AWS;
  • Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada como DevOps em um ambiente de TI, com ênfase em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Proficiência em Terraform para laC;
  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;
  • Conhecimento sólido em monitoramento e soluções de automação;
  • Familiaridade com integração das pipelines com ferramentas de análise de código e segurança, como, por exemplo, Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe

Será um diferencial

  • Conhecimento em ZapProxy, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center;
  • Certificações relevantes da AWS

O que oferecemos

title: Srum Master
description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Scrum Master?

Sua missão será atuar como facilitador da cultura ágil, promovendo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e uso adequado de ferramentas utilizadas. Você apoiará as equipes na avaliação de demandas e recursos, acompanhará KPIs e OKRs, e atuará de forma consultiva junto a Product Owners e lideranças.

Essa é uma oportunidade no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Como Scrum Master, você focará em:

  • Avaliar junto as gerências técnicas as demandas, viabilidade, alocação de recursos e cronogramas estratégicos.
  • Estabelecer e manter os padrões de gestão de projetos e métodos ágeis (Scrum, PMBOK etc.).
  • Garantir a utilização adequada das ferramentas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, GANTT CHART).
  • Implantar e monitorar KPIs e OKRs da área, promovendo gestão baseada em dados.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e proativa junto aos Product Owners e líderes de tecnologia.
  • Promover iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
  • Buscar tendências, ferramentas e boas práticas de mercado aplicáveis à realidade da empresa.
  • Avaliar oportunidades de automação, inteligência de dados e eficiência operacional.
  • Estimular cultura de colaboração, autonomia, melhoria contínua e aprendizado.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Como requisitos básicos, buscamos:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ágeis, preferencialmente Azure DevOps.
  • Conhecimento prático dos frameworks Scrum.
  • Vivência em Gestão de Projetos tradicional.
  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar métricas de desempenho ágil (burnup, burndown, velocity).
  • Certificação Scrum Master (CSM, PSM I ou equivalente).
  • Experiência com indicadores de performance.

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Experiência no sistema Service Now.
  • Experiência com projetos de alta complexidade.
  • Certificações adicionais (Kanban KMP, SAFe, PMI-ACP).
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps.
  • Experiência em processos de transformação ágil em grandes organizações.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

O que você irá encontrar por aqui?

Acreditamos que um bom profissional, antes de tudo, é uma pessoa que cuida do seu corpo e da sua mente. E, para isso, você poderá contar com alguns benefícios como:

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.

Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operation Center
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials

  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Previous professional experience working or leading a Security Operation Center
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO27001

Optional things we value

  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)

Software has moved to play a central role in network technology. From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers.

We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.

You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.

The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements

  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Experience developing and launching products

  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description:
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI

Light – Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).
Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

title: Principal Product Engineer - Americas
description:
Overview

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as individual contributors—where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

We believe in ownership and autonomy, with engineers taking end-to-end responsibility for projects. You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. Examples of how product engineers at Ashby contribute include:

  • Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app.
  • Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
  • Spec’d, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby.
What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. TA software didn’t help. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling.

We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

  • You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure.
  • You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity and thrive at the intersection of the two.
  • You know how to balance speed and quality. We moved with urgency, while delivering a high-quality product that encouraged customer adoption.
  • You’re ambitious and open to feedback to level up.
  • You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator and can work with stakeholders to ship products.
  • You seek to create leverage in your work through automation and abstractions.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You view tech leads or principals as project managers and require sign-offs.
  • You need company-wide processes to drive your projects.
  • You only want exciting work and dislike customer issues and investigations being distributed across the team.
  • You get lost in details and prefer everything planned upfront.
  • You haven’t led or owned projects before.
  • You want to mentor many junior engineers; our team is largely senior and mentorship opportunities are limited.
Engineering Culture

Our culture is grounded in ownership and collaboration. We aim for a small, talented team that can ship high-quality software fast and maintain reasonable work hours. We focus on:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers deliver magical outcomes with minimal oversight while keeping stakeholders informed. We prefer engineers who own their problems end-to-end rather than rely on heavy processes.

Technology Stack

TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis. Experience with these is not required, but a love of typed languages helps. Engineers who have switched from other languages are welcome; what matters is fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget
  • $100/month education budget
  • Health insurance for you and dependents (fully covered by Ashby in the US; in other countries, high-quality supplemental insurance is provided)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.
